source: IBPS CRP PO/MT notification and syllabus (ibps.in) and past paper pattern
intro: Prelims is a qualifying screen of English, quantitative aptitude and reasoning. Mains adds general, economy and banking awareness and data analysis, plus a descriptive paper of essay and letter or comprehension writing.
note: IBPS lists the test names and the broad areas in its notification. The topic lists below are the areas that keep repeating in past papers, so treat them as a practical checklist.

sections.name: English Language
topics: Reading comprehension
Cloze test and para jumbles
Error spotting, fill in the blanks, sentence improvement, phrase replacement
Vocabulary: word usage, synonyms and antonyms, idioms

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude and Data Analysis
topics: Simplification and approximation, number series, quadratic equations
Data interpretation: tables, bar and line graphs, pie charts, caselets, missing data
Arithmetic word problems: percentage, ratio, average, profit and loss, interest, time and work, speed and distance, mixtures
Mensuration, permutation and combination, probability
Data sufficiency (mains)

sections.name: Reasoning Ability
topics: Puzzles and seating arrangements (linear, circular, floor and box based)
Syllogism and inequalities
Blood relations, direction sense, coding and decoding, order and ranking
Input and output, data sufficiency
Higher order reasoning: statement and assumption, course of action, inference (mains)

sections.name: General, Economy and Banking Awareness
topics: Current affairs of the last several months, especially finance and economy
Banking awareness: RBI functions and policy, types of banks, payment systems, financial inclusion, recent banking news
Budget, economic survey and government schemes
Static GK: important days, awards, organisations, headquarters

sections.name: Descriptive Paper
topics: One essay and one letter or comprehension-type writing task, in English, written by typing on the screen
Topics are broadly on economic and social issues, banking and technology trends, current events and ethics
sections.tip: Practise typing full answers on the keyboard within the time limit, because the descriptive paper is typed in the exam.

sections.name: Personality test and interview
topics: Your graduation subjects, banking and economy awareness, home state and bank preferences, current events
